$comment: Curated OSV exceptions for scripts/osv-audit.mjs. Every entry names the advisory, why it is not reachable in this app, and an expiry date. Expired entries fail CI. History: 57 instances at the 2026-10-12 re-audit; 6 curated ignores after remediation; 5 of the 6 eliminated on 2026-10-12 (score-max program) via pnpm overrides — stream-json removed from the graph entirely (jayson 4.2.0 -> 5.0.0 dropped the dependency), uuid 8.3.2 -> 11.1.1, postcss-selector-parser 6.x -> 7.1.6 — leaving only the entry below.

ignores.reason: Stack-exhaustion DoS via deeply nested patterns (CVE-2026-93687). braces runs only at build time (micromatch/chokidar in the Tailwind/ESLint toolchain) on the project's own file globs; no user input reaches it. Re-checked 2026-10-12: upstream still has NO fixed release (first_patched_version is null; latest and only 3.x is 3.0.3, published 2024-05-21), and every parent in this graph is already at its line-latest, so there is no version to override to. Eliminating it would require a Tailwind 4 migration or dropping the Tailwind/ESLint tooling. Recheck at expiry.
